retrievalProfile.description: Generates high-contrast, low-key portraits of a muscular subject draped in a flag, characterized by heavy chiaroscuro and gritty skin textures.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, low-key portrait of a shirtless, muscular man with curly hair and a mustache, his skin covered in sweat and dark smudges. He is positioned centrally, holding a large, weathered flag behind his shoulders like a cape. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and highlighting the anatomical definition of the torso against a pitch-black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a void-like black background
Flag texture contrasting with wet, gritty skin
Horizontal arm extension creating a T-shape composition
coreInvariants: Deep chiaroscuro lighting with near-total black shadows
Visible skin grit, sweat, and dark smudges
Flag draped behind the subject's outstretched arms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, torso and head filling the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated chest and abdominal muscles.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the brightly lit face looking off-camera, moves down the defined torso, and follows the horizontal lines of the flag.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounding the head and upper shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark shadows (background and recesses).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and off-white flag stripes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted reds and blues from the flag.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; colors are desaturated and weathered.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use cream or off-white for highlights

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast cinematic portrait of a muscular man with curly hair and a mustache, skin covered in sweat and dirt, holding a weathered flag behind him against a black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a bold, distressed serif font in a muted cream color, positioned in the lower third with high tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture gritty with visible sweat and dirt?
Is the flag weathered and desaturated?

adjustableVariables: Direction of the primary light source

mustAchieve: Tactile texture on skin and fabric

postGenerationChecks: Check for realistic muscle anatomy under harsh light
Ensure the flag texture looks like heavy fabric, not digital overlay
Verify the eyes have a subtle catchlight despite the shadows
Confirm the background is free of light leaks or artifacts
recipe.reuseFormula: Cinematic low-key portrait + [Subject Description] + [Flag Type] + gritty skin texture + chiaroscuro lighting + black background.
